content: Both Caido and ZAP have a Sequencer-equivalent, but neither ships it in core: Caido's is a community plugin (caido-community/sequencer, GitHub) built on the plugin SDK; ZAP's is the 'Token Generation and Analysis' add-on from its Marketplace. Signal: real tester demand exists (both ecosystems produced one) but neither vendor considered it important enough to bundle by default. For burpsy, reasonable to keep it in core for now (no plugin system yet) but treat as P2, and a good candidate flagship demo once the plugin API ships.
